## Misbehaviour authority

How reports of bad messages reach the MA and how the MA decides. Covers what a vehicle stores and uploads, how the RA shuffles reports, the MA's decision rule, and whether a person reviews each case. The US pilots used manual review.

| Setting | Type | Unit | Default | Range or choices | Level | Status | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <span id="s-detection-ma-id"></span>`detection.ma.id` | string | | `threat/ma/corroborated` | `threat/ma/corroborated`, `threat/ma/legacy-window`<br>recommended Corroborated, which needs reports from several vehicles. | basic | :material-check-circle:{ title="Active" } `wired` | The model's registry id. The misbehaviour authority: the backend service that reads reports and decides whom to revoke. |

## Choices

The labelled values of every closed or model setting above.

??? note "`detection.perception_tier`"

 | Value | Label | Meaning |
 |---|---|---|
 | `abstract` | Fast (abstract) | Closed-form stand-ins: cheapest, for very large fleets; least faithful. |
 | `medium` | Standard (medium) | The models the literature agrees on, without frame-level detail. The usual choice. |
 | `high` | Detailed (high) | Frame-level or geometry-traced detail: the most faithful and the slowest. |

??? note "`detection.local[].id`"

 | Value | Label | Meaning |
 |---|---|---|
 | `detect/legacy-12` | Standard 12-check suite | Plausibility and consistency checks on every message (the VeReMi detector set). |
 | `detect/us-sm-mbr` | Strict US profile (SM-MBR) | Only the SCMS Manager BSM report subtypes at their published thresholds (1 m drift, 90 m/s, 10 m/s²), every BSM checked, no streak gate (the default under a US deployment). |
 | `detect/ts103759` | ETSI TS 103 759 observations | The European observation classes 1-5 with F2MD's checks, a Kalman track, the reachable-distance envelope and vehicle-box overlap, every message checked; its thresholds, units and sources are on the threat/detector/ts103759-observations card. |

??? note "`detection.ma.id`"

 | Value | Label | Meaning |
 |---|---|---|
 | `threat/ma/corroborated` | Corroborating authority | Revokes only on independent, corroborated evidence sustained over time. |
 | `threat/ma/legacy-window` | Legacy window authority | Revokes once three trusted reporters agree within a window: the legacy engine's rule, kept for parity. |
